claim: Blood's monuments are stepped bases of raised sectors under open sky: 421 over 66 maps of the campaign, Bloodbath and curated community maps, two tiers in 389 and three in 30, a tier rising a median 0.42 bodies, the base 2.0 plan units and the top a third of it (0.62). Only 77 carry anything, and that is light (23 an invisible generator, type 709 on tile 2520): Blood has no figure-on-a-plinth idiom.
evidence: 421 monuments over 66 maps, by tools/mine_monuments.py (figures in projects/blood-city/level/templates.py)
use: Build a monument as concentric tiers each carved from the one below; crown it with a flame.
